title: Cosmic Sorceress Ritual
description: A mystical woman with long dark hair and a starry robe sits at the center of a large circular stone platform resembling a labyrinth or zodiac wheel. She reaches toward glowing ethereal blue figures and an open ancient book while a white bird flies above and a floating orb containing a smaller meditating figure hovers nearby, all set against a vibrant cosmic background of stars, nebulae, aurora, constellations, and glowing lotus flowers.
